headline: Jordan turns first-handstand ambition into a five-minute daily practice target
overview: The real iPhone app captures Jordan's current ability, suggests measurable first goals, and explains why an account is useful before asking for one.
payoff: Jordan reaches sync with a five-second hold target and five-minute daily practice already visible.

scenes.title: Establish an honest baseline
scenes.narrative: Jordan begins in the native app and identifies as working toward a first handstand.

scenes.title: Accept a measurable starting point
scenes.narrative: The native setup suggests a five-second hold and five minutes per day, then offers account sync without forcing a provider selection during the walk.
